thermal_limits: Metal area is not an effective-heatsink-area or Rtheta guarantee. ST Fig10 uses a particular FR4/35um setup.
D1031.6C/W is junction-to-case/tab, not mold top to air. Never substitute it for actual RthetaJA.
Diode guard uses engineering0.75V and datasheet125C/100V leakage as a screening value, not all-temperature guaranteed model.
U101 Rds190mohm comes from stated TI test conditions; trise,Qg use example approximations and omit complete switching/core/interaction losses.
Legacy Ta50C is retained alongside user-requested40C. 15C neighboring rise is sensitivity, not a solved board thermal coupling.
No waveform, actual junction, thermal resistance, short-circuit or enclosed-airflow measurement exists.

limits: Finite passive-load LTI sensitivity only; no proof of stability with AP63203 constant-power input, mode transitions, long-path inductance, wiring or all ESR/temperature corners.
C108/C121 ESR22mohm maximum is specified at100kHz/conditions; .001/.044 bounds are engineering sensitivities, not manufacturer broadband guarantees.
C11927mohm is the stated100kHz value, not broadband minimum.
C108,C121180uF and C11982uF retained; no compensation component changed.
TI12A/V,350uS,10kDCgain,2.5MHzEA values are simplified model/example assumptions, not complete guaranteed closed-loop parameters.
A half-cycle pure delay is a sensitivity assumption, not an identified PWM model.
